stories.title: Warren Buffett steps down as Berkshire chair; son Howard succeeds him
new_facts: Buffett, 96, steps down as Berkshire chairman effective immediately; son Howard becomes new chairman.
Notes Buffett had already stepped down as Berkshire CEO last year.
Adds on-record quote: 'Father Time always wins' from Buffett.
Adds chair emeritus title, $1tn valuation, 60-year tenure, Howard's age (71), and Buffett's great-grandchild quote.
Reveals the succession was dictated by a long-standing succession plan.
Identifies the source of the 'Father Time always wins' quote as a letter to shareholders.
stories.line: Warren Buffett steps down as Berkshire Hathaway chair after 50+ years; his son Howard takes over.

stories.title: Pentagon releases classified UFO files and videos from 1952
new_facts: Pentagon released a new batch of UAP/UFO files, including documents on a secretive military program studying aerospace threats.

1952 orb footage was filmed by a US Navy officer who reported it to the Air Force's UFO investigation programme.
stories.line: Pentagon released documents on a classified military UFO program, including 1952 footage and video of unidentified aerial objects.

stories.title: Juror in Clancy mistrial goes into hiding after voting guilty
new_facts: Names the holdout juror as Michael Desronvil; he says he "didn't have any doubts" during deliberations.
Desronvil has gone into hiding; his lawyer warns against searching for him; fundraiser has raised $280k.
Desronvil's attorney says he will not be giving further interviews about the deliberations.
Desronvil says he had no doubt Clancy deliberately killed her children, rejecting the insanity claim.
Lindsay Clancy's former husband and his new wife speak publicly for the first time about their grief.
Judge Judy Sheindlin publicly warns of 'danger' if prosecutors do not retry Lindsay Clancy.
stories.line: A juror who voted guilty in the Lindsay Clancy murder trial is now in hiding after the jury deadlocked; he says he had no doubts of her guilt.
